cases.purpose: Explicit operands and enumeration resolve actual sysfs-style partition links and decode independently encoded DOS and GPT parent IDs; repeated -s selects both tags.
cases.oracle: Fixed independently encoded MBR and GPT bytes.
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p dev sys tree/disk tree/disk/disk1 tree/gdisk tree/gdisk/gdisk1
ln -s ../tree/disk/disk1 sys/disk1
ln -s ../tree/gdisk/gdisk1 sys/gdisk1
printf '1\n' > tree/disk/disk1/partition
printf '1\n' > tree/gdisk/gdisk1/partition
python3 - <<'PYFIX'
import struct, uuid
from pathlib import Path
m = bytearray(65536)
struct.pack_into('<I', m, 440, 0xc0ffee01)
m[450] = 0x83
struct.pack_into('<II', m, 454, 64, 100)
m[510:512] = b'\x55\xaa'
Path('dev/disk').write_bytes(m)
g = bytearray(65536)
g[512:520] = b'EFI PART'
g[568:584] = uuid.UUID('44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444').bytes_le
struct.pack_into('<QII', g, 584, 2, 128, 128)
g[1024:1040] = uuid.UUID('0fc63daf-8483-4772-8e79-3d69d8477de4').bytes_le
g[1040:1056] = uuid.UUID('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555551').bytes_le
g[1080:1096] = 'PARTNAME'.encode('utf-16le')
Path('dev/gdisk').write_bytes(g)
Path('dev/disk1').write_bytes(bytes(4096))
Path('dev/gdisk1').write_bytes(bytes(4096))
PYFIX
cases.script:
set -o pipefail
export BASHBLKID_SYS_BLOCK_DIR=$PWD/sys BASHBLKID_DEV_ROOT=$PWD/dev
blkid -s PARTUUID -o value "$PWD/dev/disk1" || exit $?
blkid -s PARTUUID -o value "$PWD/dev/gdisk1" || exit $?
blkid -s PARTLABEL -o value "$PWD/dev/gdisk1" || exit $?
blkid -s PTUUID -o value "$PWD/dev/disk" || exit $?
blkid -s PTUUID -o value "$PWD/dev/gdisk" || exit $?
blkid -s PTUUID -s PTTYPE "$PWD/dev/disk" | sed "s|$PWD|ROOT|" || exit $?
blkid -s PARTUUID -o value | sort || exit $?
